findings.summary: U-3V3 pin PG (__unnamed_65) missing pull-up resistor
findings.description: Pin PG on U-3V3 (TPSM828224SILR) is connected to net __unnamed_65 but has no pull-up resistor. This pin type typically requires an external pull-up to a power rail for correct operation.
findings.recommendation: Add a 4.7k-10k pull-up resistor from __unnamed_65 to the appropriate power rail.

fix_params.basis: Pin PG is open-drain/input type requiring pull-up

report_context.impact: Pin may float or bus may not function without pull-up

top_issues.description: Pin PG on U-3V3 (TPSM828224SILR) is connected to net __unnamed_65 but has no pull-up resistor. This pin type typically requires an external pull-up to a power rail for correct operation.
top_issues.recommendation: Add a 4.7k-10k pull-up resistor from __unnamed_65 to the appropriate power rail.

fix_params.basis: Pin PG is open-drain/input type requiring pull-up

report_context.impact: Pin may float or bus may not function without pull-up

top_issues.description: Net +5V carries power_in pins but has no power_out pin, no PWR_FLAG, no regulator output mapping, and no bridged solder jumper path to a sourced net.
top_issues.recommendation: Add a PWR_FLAG to declare the rail as externally powered (e.g. from a connector) or trace the rail back to a regulator output. If the source lives on another sheet, promote the net name to a global label.

report_context.impact: Rail has no source visible to the analyser; likely a wiring gap or missing PWR_FLAG.
